rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an ox or other cattle in ordinary speech.

example.english: The ox pulls the cart along slowly.
example.jyutping: ngau4 laai1 zyu6 gaa3 ce1 maan6 maan6 hang4

rows.note: Use this when it is important to specify that the male cattle has been castrated.

example.english: The farmer specifically bought a castrated ox to plough the fields.
example.traditional: 農夫特登買咗隻閹牛嚟耕田。
example.jyutping: nung4 fu1 dak6 dang1 maai5 zo2 zek3 jim1 ngau4 lai4 gaang1 tin4
